{}-- pj-filter: luau -- SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0 -- -- The 12 PJ4 built-in data filters as ONE self-describing multi-class resource. -- The module returns a LIST of class tables; the host registers each. The IDs are -- the canonical builtin ids (so old layouts resolve). Behavior is golden-tested in -- pj_scripting/tests/builtin_golden_test.cpp (the C++ builtins that were the -- original parity oracle were retired once the Luau twins matched them). -- -- Each filter is an idiomatic Luau CLASS: a table holding the descriptor metadata -- plus the shared methods, with `Class.__index = Class`; `Class.create(params)` -- returns `setmetatable(state, Class)`, and `:calculate`/`:reset` operate on `self`. -- The host resolves the methods through the metatable and binds `self` per call. -- -- TIME CONTRACT: calculate(self, t, v) receives t = SECONDS SINCE SESSION START -- (the host rebases the int64-ns spine before the double cast); returning (t_out, v) -- emits at an explicit time. See pj_scripting/docs/FILTER_CLASS.md.
local function clampWindow(w) w = math.floor(w or 1) if w < 1 then return 1 end return w end
-- none: pass the value through unchanged. output mirrors the input kind. local None = { id = "none", name = "None", description = "Pass-through (no change).", output = "same" } None.__index = None function None.create(_) return setmetatable({}, None) end function None:calculate(_, v) return v end
-- absolute: |v|. mirrors the input kind (|int64| stays int64 in C++; the Luau -- twin emits double, exact below 2^53 — documented in the parity test). local Absolute = { id = "absolute", name = "Absolute", description = "Absolute value |y|.", output = "same" } Absolute.__index = Absolute function Absolute.create(_) return setmetatable({}, Absolute) end function Absolute:calculate(_, v) return math.abs(v) end
-- scale: affine value_scale*y + value_offset, with a rigid time shift. local Scale = { id = "scale", name = "Scale", description = "Affine scale + offset, with a time shift.", parameters = { { name = "value_scale", type = "number", default = 1.0, label = "Scale" }, { name = "value_offset", type = "number", default = 0.0, label = "Offset" }, { name = "time_offset_sec", type = "number", default = 0.0, label = "Time offset", unit = "s" }, }, } Scale.__index = Scale function Scale.create(p) return setmetatable({ k = p.value_scale, b = p.value_offset, dt = p.time_offset_sec }, Scale) end function Scale:calculate(t, v) return t + self.dt, self.k * v + self.b end
-- derivative: dv/dt. first sample suppressed; dt==0 -> 0 (finite). local Derivative = { id = "derivative", name = "Derivative", description = "Rate of change dv/dt.", parameters = { { name = "use_custom_dt", type = "boolean", default = false, label = "Use fixed Δt" }, { name = "custom_dt", type = "number", default = 1.0, label = "Fixed Δt", unit = "s", min = 1e-9, visible_when = { param = "use_custom_dt", equals = true } }, }, } Derivative.__index = Derivative function Derivative.create(p) return setmetatable( { use_custom = p.use_custom_dt, fixed = p.custom_dt, has_prev = false, pt = 0.0, pv = 0.0 }, Derivative) end function Derivative:reset() self.has_prev = false end function Derivative:calculate(t, v) if not self.has_prev then self.has_prev, self.pt, self.pv = true, t, v; return nil end local dt = self.use_custom and self.fixed or (t - self.pt) local d = (dt ~= 0.0) and (v - self.pv) / dt or 0.0 self.pt, self.pv = t, v return d end
-- integral: running trapezoidal area. first sample suppressed. local Integral = { id = "integral", name = "Integral", description = "Running trapezoidal integral of y over time.", parameters = { { name = "use_custom_dt", type = "boolean", default = false, label = "Use fixed Δt" }, { name = "custom_dt", type = "number", default = 1.0, label = "Fixed Δt", unit = "s", min = 1e-9, visible_when = { param = "use_custom_dt", equals = true } }, }, } Integral.__index = Integral function Integral.create(p) return setmetatable( { use_custom = p.use_custom_dt, fixed = p.custom_dt, acc = 0.0, has_prev = false, pt = 0.0, pv = 0.0 }, Integral) end function Integral:reset() self.acc, self.has_prev = 0.0, false end function Integral:calculate(t, v) if not self.has_prev then self.has_prev, self.pt, self.pv = true, t, v; return nil end local dt = self.use_custom and self.fixed or (t - self.pt) self.acc = self.acc + (v + self.pv) * dt / 2.0 self.pt, self.pv = t, v return self.acc end
-- moving_average: boxcar over `window`, PJ3 "pad-with-current" quirk (divide by -- the full window, missing slots padded with the current value). Optional -- de-phase: center the output timestamp on the buffered span. local MovingAverage = { id = "moving_average", name = "Moving Average", description = "Boxcar moving average.", parameters = { { name = "window", type = "integer", default = 100, min = 1, label = "Window" }, { name = "compensate_time_offset", type = "boolean", default = false, label = "Center timestamp" }, }, } MovingAverage.__index = MovingAverage function MovingAverage.create(p) return setmetatable({ window = p.window, compensate = p.compensate_time_offset, bt = {}, bv = {} }, MovingAverage) end function MovingAverage:reset() self.bt, self.bv = {}, {} end function MovingAverage:calculate(t, v) local w = clampWindow(self.window) local bt, bv = self.bt, self.bv bt[#bt + 1] = t; bv[#bv + 1] = v while #bt > w do table.remove(bt, 1); table.remove(bv, 1) end local total = v * (w - #bv) for i = 1, #bv do total = total + bv[i] end local avg = total / w if self.compensate and #bt > 1 then return bt[1] + (bt[#bt] - bt[1]) / 2, avg end return avg end
-- moving_rms: sqrt(mean of squares) over `window`, pad-with-current. local MovingRms = { id = "moving_rms", name = "Moving Root Mean Squared", description = "Moving RMS over a window.", parameters = { { name = "window", type = "integer", default = 100, min = 1, label = "Window" } }, } MovingRms.__index = MovingRms function MovingRms.create(p) return setmetatable({ window = p.window, buf = {} }, MovingRms) end function MovingRms:reset() self.buf = {} end function MovingRms:calculate(_, v) local w = clampWindow(self.window) local buf = self.buf buf[#buf + 1] = v while #buf > w do table.remove(buf, 1) end local total = (v * v) * (w - #buf) for i = 1, #buf do total = total + buf[i] * buf[i] end return math.sqrt(total / w) end
-- moving_variance: variance (or stdev) over `window`, pad-with-current. local MovingVariance = { id = "moving_variance", name = "Moving Variance / Stdev", description = "Moving variance or standard deviation.", parameters = { { name = "window", type = "integer", default = 100, min = 1, label = "Window" }, { name = "std_dev", type = "boolean", default = false, label = "Standard deviation" }, }, } MovingVariance.__index = MovingVariance function MovingVariance.create(p) return setmetatable({ window = p.window, want_std = p.std_dev, buf = {} }, MovingVariance) end function MovingVariance:reset() self.buf = {} end function MovingVariance:calculate(_, v) local w = clampWindow(self.window) local buf = self.buf buf[#buf + 1] = v while #buf > w do table.remove(buf, 1) end local pad = w - #buf local total = v * pad for i = 1, #buf do total = total + buf[i] end local avg = total / w local total_sqr = (v - avg) * (v - avg) * pad for i = 1, #buf do local d = buf[i] - avg; total_sqr = total_sqr + d * d end local var = total_sqr / w return self.want_std and math.sqrt(var) or var end
-- outlier_removal: drop a one-sample spike (PJ3 4-sample ring). Emits the -- PREVIOUS sample (one-sample delay) or suppresses; value passed through. local function isOutlier(factor, y0, y1, y2, y3) local d1, d2 = y1 - y2, y2 - y3 if d1 * d2 < 0 then local d0 = y0 - y1 local jump = math.max(math.abs(d1), math.abs(d2)) local ratio = (d0 == 0.0) and math.huge or (jump / math.abs(d0)) if ratio > factor then return true end end return false end
local OutlierRemoval = { id = "outlier_removal", name = "Outlier Removal", description = "Drop single-sample spikes.", output = "same", parameters = { { name = "outlier_factor", type = "number", default = 100.0, min = 0.0, label = "Factor" } }, } OutlierRemoval.__index = OutlierRemoval function OutlierRemoval.create(p) return setmetatable({ factor = p.outlier_factor, rt = {}, rv = {} }, OutlierRemoval) end function OutlierRemoval:reset() self.rt, self.rv = {}, {} end function OutlierRemoval:calculate(t, v) local rt, rv = self.rt, self.rv rt[#rt + 1] = t; rv[#rv + 1] = v while #rt > 4 do table.remove(rt, 1); table.remove(rv, 1) end if #rt < 4 then return t, v end -- not enough look-back: pass through if isOutlier(self.factor, rv[1], rv[2], rv[3], rv[4]) then return nil end return rt[3], rv[3] -- emit the previous sample (i-1) end
-- samples_counter: how many samples fall in the trailing `samples_ms` window. local SamplesCounter = { id = "samples_counter", name = "Samples Counter", description = "Count of samples in a trailing time window.", output = "int64", parameters = { { name = "samples_ms", type = "number", default = 1000.0, min = 0.0, label = "Window", unit = "ms" } }, } SamplesCounter.__index = SamplesCounter -- Head-pointer ring (live window is buf[head..tail]) so front-eviction is O(1) -- amortized rather than O(n) table.remove — the window can be large. function SamplesCounter.create(p) return setmetatable({ samples_ms = p.samples_ms, buf = {}, head = 1, tail = 0 }, SamplesCounter) end function SamplesCounter:reset() self.buf, self.head, self.tail = {}, 1, 0 end function SamplesCounter:calculate(t, _) local window_s = (self.samples_ms > 0.0) and (self.samples_ms * 1e-3) or 0.0 local buf = self.buf local head, tail = self.head, self.tail tail = tail + 1 buf[tail] = t local min_t = t - window_s while head <= tail and buf[head] < min_t do buf[head] = nil head = head + 1 end if head > 4096 then -- compact so the array can't grow unbounded over a long stream local n = 0 for i = head, tail do n = n + 1; buf[n] = buf[i]; buf[i] = nil end head, tail = 1, n end self.head, self.tail = head, tail return tail - head + 1 end
-- binary_filter: 0/1 predicate. binary_op is the int index of the comparison -- (kept identical to the C++ enum for layout round-trip): 0== 1< 2<= 3> 4>= 5range. local BinaryFilter = { id = "binary_filter", name = "Binary Filter", description = "Boolean 0/1 predicate over the value.", output = "int64", parameters = { { name = "binary_op", type = "enum", default = 3, label = "Comparison", values = { { value = 0, label = "== a" }, { value = 1, label = "< a" }, { value = 2, label = "<= a" }, { value = 3, label = "> a" }, { value = 4, label = ">= a" }, { value = 5, label = "in [a, b]" }, } }, { name = "binary_a", type = "number", default = 0.0, label = "Threshold a" }, { name = "binary_b", type = "number", default = 0.0, label = "Threshold b", visible_when = { param = "binary_op", equals = 5 } }, { name = "binary_tol", type = "number", default = 1e-9, label = "Tolerance (==)", visible_when = { param = "binary_op", equals = 0 } }, }, } BinaryFilter.__index = BinaryFilter function BinaryFilter.create(p) local op = math.floor(tonumber(p.binary_op) or 3) -- tolerate a string-typed enum value return setmetatable({ op = op, a = p.binary_a, b = p.binary_b, tol = p.binary_tol }, BinaryFilter) end function BinaryFilter:calculate(_, v) local op, a, b, tol = self.op, self.a, self.b, self.tol local pass if op == 0 then pass = math.abs(v - a) <= tol elseif op == 1 then pass = v < a elseif op == 2 then pass = v <= a elseif op == 3 then pass = v > a elseif op == 4 then pass = v >= a elseif op == 5 then pass = (a <= v) and (v <= b) else pass = false end return pass and 1 or 0 end
-- time_since_previous: gap to the previous sample, in SECONDS (double). first -- sample suppressed. (t is seconds-since-start, so the gap is a plain difference — -- double preserves sub-second deltas that an int64 output would truncate to 0.) local TimeSincePrevious = { id = "time_since_previous", name = "Time Since Previous", description = "Δt between consecutive samples (seconds).", output = "double", } TimeSincePrevious.__index = TimeSincePrevious function TimeSincePrevious.create(_) return setmetatable({ has_prev = false, pt = 0.0 }, TimeSincePrevious) end function TimeSincePrevious:reset() self.has_prev = false end function TimeSincePrevious:calculate(t, _) if not self.has_prev then self.has_prev, self.pt = true, t; return nil end local delta_sec = (t - self.pt) self.pt = t return delta_sec end
return { None, Absolute, Scale, Derivative, Integral, MovingAverage, MovingRms, MovingVariance, OutlierRemoval, SamplesCounter, BinaryFilter, TimeSincePrevious, }
